1.text: Now in tha first year of Cyrus king of Persia, dat tha word of tha LORD by tha mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, tha LORD stirred up tha spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, dat he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, N put it also in writing, sayin,
Like dis says Cyrus king of Persia, tha LORD God of heaven has given me all tha kingdoms of tha earth; N he has charged me 2 build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
Who is there among u of all his people? his God be wit him, N let him go up 2 Jerusalem, which is in Judah, N build tha house of tha LORD God of Israel, (he is tha God,) which is in Jerusalem.

N whoever remains in any place where he stays, let tha men of his place help him wit silver, N wit gold, N wit goods, N wit beasts, beside tha freewill offering 4 tha house of God dat is in Jerusalem.
Then rose up tha chief of tha fathers of Judah N Benjamin, N tha priests, N tha Levites, wit all ’em whose spirit God had raised, 2 go up 2 build tha house of tha LORD which is in Jerusalem.
N all dey dat were about ’em strengthened their hands wit vessels of silver, wit gold, wit goods, N wit beasts, N wit precious things, beside all dat was willingly offered.
Also Cyrus tha king brought forth tha vessels of tha house of tha LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, N had put ’em in tha house of his gods;
Even dose did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by tha hand of Mithredath tha treasurer, N numbered ’em 2 Sheshbazzar, tha prince of Judah.
N dis is tha number of ’em: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine N twenty knives,
Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred N ten, N other vessels a thousand.
All tha vessels of gold N of silver were five thousand N four hundred. All dese did Sheshbazzar bring up wit ’em of tha captivity dat were brought up from Babylon 2 Jerusalem.

2.text: Now dese r tha children of tha province dat went up out of tha captivity, of dose which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar tha king of Babylon had carried away 2 Babylon, N came again 2 Jerusalem N Judah, every one 2 his city;
Which came wit Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. tha number of tha men of tha people of Israel:
Tha children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy N two.
Tha children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy N two.
Tha children of Arah, seven hundred seventy N five.
Tha children of Pahath-moab, of tha children of Jeshua N Joab, two thousand eight hundred N twelve.
Tha children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty N four.
Tha children of Zattu, nine hundred forty N five.
Tha children of Zaccai, seven hundred N threescore.
Tha children of Bani, six hundred forty N two.
Tha children of Bebai, six hundred twenty N three.
Tha children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred twenty N two.
Tha children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty N six.
Tha children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty N six.
Tha children of Adin, four hundred fifty N four.
Tha children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety N eight.
Tha children of Bezai, three hundred twenty N three.
Tha children of Jorah, an hundred N twelve.
Tha children of Hashum, two hundred twenty N three.
Tha children of Gibbar, ninety N five.
Tha children of Beth-lehem, an hundred twenty N three.
Tha men of Netophah, fifty N six.
Tha men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty N eight.
Tha children of Azmaveth, forty N two.
Tha children of Kirjath-arim, Chephirah, N Beeroth, seven hundred N forty N three.
Tha children of Ramah N Gaba, six hundred twenty N one.
Tha men of Michmas, an hundred twenty N two.
Tha men of Beth-el N Ai, two hundred twenty N three.
Tha children of Nebo, fifty N two.
Tha children of Magbish, an hundred fifty N six.
Tha children of tha other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty N four.
Tha children of Harim, three hundred N twenty.
Tha children of Lod, Hadid, N Ono, seven hundred twenty N five.
Tha children of Jericho, three hundred forty N five.
Tha children of Senaah, three thousand N six hundred N thirty.
Tha priests: tha children of Jedaiah, of tha house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy N three.
Tha children of Immer, a thousand fifty N two.
Tha children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty N seven.
Tha children of Harim, a thousand N seventeen.
Tha Levites: tha children of Jeshua N Kadmiel, of tha children of Hodaviah, seventy N four.
Tha singers: tha children of Asaph, an hundred twenty N eight.

Tha children of tha porters: tha children of Shallum, tha children of Ater, tha children of Talmon, tha children of Akkub, tha children of Hatita, tha children of Shobai, in all an hundred thirty N nine.
Tha Nethinims: tha children of Ziha, tha children of Hasupha, tha children of Tabbaoth,
Tha children of Keros, tha children of Siaha, tha children of Padon,
Tha children of Lebanah, tha children of Hagabah, tha children of Akkub,
Tha children of Hagab, tha children of Shalmai, tha children of Hanan,
Tha children of Giddel, tha children of Gahar, tha children of Reaiah,
Tha children of Rezin, tha children of Nekoda, tha children of Gazzam,
Tha children of Uzza, tha children of Paseah, tha children of Besai,
Tha children of Asnah, tha children of Mehunim, tha children of Nephusim,
Tha children of Bakbuk, tha children of Hakupha, tha children of Harhur,
Tha children of Bazluth, tha children of Mehida, tha children of Harsha,
Tha children of Barkos, tha children of Sisera, tha children of Thamah,
Tha children of Neziah, tha children of Hatipha.
Tha children of Solomon’s servants: tha children of Sotai, tha children of Sophereth, tha children of Peruda,
Tha children of Jaalah, tha children of Darkon, tha children of Giddel,
Tha children of Shephatiah, tha children of Hattil, tha children of Pochereth of Zebaim, tha children of Ami.
All tha Nethinims, N tha children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety N two.
N dese were dey which went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, N Immer: but dey could not show their father’s house, N their seed, whether dey were of Israel:
Tha children of Delaiah, tha children of Tobiah, tha children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty N two.

N of tha children of tha priests: tha children of Habaiah, tha children of Koz, tha children of Barzillai; which took a wife of tha daughters of Barzillai tha Gileadite, N was called after their name:
Dese sought their register among dose dat were reckoned by genealogy, but dey were not found: therefore were dey, as polluted, put from tha priesthood.
N tha Tirshatha said 2 ’em, dat dey should not eat of tha most holy things, till there stood up a priest wit Urim N wit Thummim.
Tha whole congregation together was forty N two thousand three hundred N threescore,
Beside their servants N their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty N seven: N there were among ’em two hundred singin men N singin women.
Their horses were seven hundred thirty N six; their mules, two hundred forty N five;
Their camels, four hundred thirty N five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred N twenty.
N some of tha chief of tha fathers, when dey came 2 tha house of tha LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely 4 tha house of God 2 set it up in his place:
Dey gave after their ability 2 tha treasure of tha work threescore N one thousand drams of gold, N five thousand pound of silver, N one hundred priests’ garments.
So tha priests, N tha Levites, N some of tha people, N tha singers, N tha porters, N tha Nethinims, lived in their citiez, N all Israel in their citiez.

3.text: N when tha seventh month was come, N tha children of Israel were in tha citiez, tha people gathered themselves together as one man 2 Jerusalem.

Then stood up Jeshua tha son of Jozadak, N his brothers tha priests, N Zerubbabel tha son of Shealtiel, N his brothers, N builded tha altar of tha God of Israel, 2 offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in tha law of Moses tha man of God.
N dey set tha altar upon his bases; 4 fear was upon ’em because of tha people of dose countries: N dey offered burnt offerings thereon 2 tha LORD, even burnt offerings morning N evening.
Dey kept also tha feast of tabernacles, as it is written, N offered tha daily burnt offerings by number, according 2 tha custom, as tha duty of every day required;
N afterward offered tha continual burnt offering, both of tha new moons, N of all tha set feasts of tha LORD dat were consecrated, N of every one dat willingly offered a freewill offering 2 tha LORD.
From tha first day of tha seventh month began dey 2 offer burnt offerings 2 tha LORD. But tha foundation of tha temple of tha LORD was not yet laid. was not yet founded

Dey gave money also 2 tha masons, N 2 tha carpenters; N food, N drink, N oil, 2 ’em of Zidon, N 2 ’em of Tyre, 2 bring cedar trees from Lebanon 2 tha sea of Joppa, according 2 tha grant dat dey had of Cyrus king of Persia.

Now in tha second year of their comin 2 tha house of God at Jerusalem, in tha second month, began Zerubbabel tha son of Shealtiel, N Jeshua tha son of Jozadak, N tha remnant of their brothers tha priests N tha Levites, N all dey dat were come out of tha captivity 2 Jerusalem; N appointed tha Levites, from twenty years old N upward, 2 set forward tha work of tha house of tha LORD.

Then stood Jeshua wit his sons N his brothers, Kadmiel N his sons, tha sons of Judah, together, 2 set forward tha workmen in tha house of God: tha sons of Henadad, wit their sons N their brothers tha Levites.

N when tha builders laid tha foundation of tha temple of tha LORD, dey set tha priests in their clothing wit trumpets, N tha Levites tha sons of Asaph wit cymbals, 2 praise tha LORD, after tha ordinance of David king of Israel.

N dey sang together by course in praising N givin thanks 2 tha LORD; because he is good, 4 his mercy endures 4 ever toward Israel. N all tha people shouted wit a great shout, when dey praised tha LORD, because tha foundation of tha house of tha LORD was laid.

But many of tha priests N Levites N chief of tha fathers, who were ancient men, dat had seen tha first house, when tha foundation of dis house was laid before their eyes, wept wit a loud voice; N many shouted aloud 4 joy:
So dat tha people could not discern tha noise of tha shout of joy from tha noise of tha weepin of tha people: 4 tha people shouted wit a loud shout, N tha noise was heard afar off.

4.text: Now when tha adversaries of Judah N Benjamin heard dat tha children of tha captivity builded tha temple 2 tha LORD God of Israel;

Then dey came 2 Zerubbabel, N 2 tha chief of tha fathers, N said 2 ’em, Let us build wit u: 4 we seek ur God, as y’all do; N we do sacrifice 2 him since tha days of Esar-haddon king of Assur, which brought us up here.

But Zerubbabel, N Jeshua, N tha rest of tha chief of tha fathers of Israel, said 2 ’em, y’all have nothing 2 do wit us 2 build an house 2 our God; but we ourselves together will build 2 tha LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus tha king of Persia has commanded us.
Then tha people of tha land weakened tha hands of tha people of Judah, N troubled ’em in buildin,
N hired counsellors against ’em, 2 frustrate their purpose, all tha days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until tha reign of Darius king of Persia.
N in tha reign of Ahasuerus, in tha beginning of his reign, wrote dey 2 him an accusation against tha inhabitants of Judah N Jerusalem.

N in tha days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, N tha rest of their companions, 2 Artaxerxes king of Persia; N tha writing of tha letter was written in tha Syrian tongue, N interpreted in tha Syrian tongue.
Rehum tha chancellor N Shimshai tha scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem 2 Artaxerxes tha king in dis sort:

Then wrote Rehum tha chancellor, N Shimshai tha scribe, N tha rest of their companions; tha Dinaites, tha Apharsathchites, tha Tarpelites, tha Apharsites, tha Archevites, tha Babylonians, tha Susanchites, tha Dehavites, N tha Elamites,
N tha rest of tha nations whom tha great N noble Asnappar brought over, N set in tha citiez of Samaria, N tha rest dat r on dis side tha river, N at such a time.
Dis is tha copy of tha letter dat dey sent 2 him, even 2 Artaxerxes tha king; ur servants tha men on dis side tha river, N at such a time.
Be it known 2 tha king, dat tha Jews which came up from u 2 us r come 2 Jerusalem, buildin tha rebellious N tha bad city, N have set up tha walls of it, N joined tha foundations.
Be it known now 2 tha king, dat, if dis city be builded, N tha walls set up again, then will dey not pay toll, tribute, N custom, N so u will endamage tha revenue of tha kings.
Now because we have maintenance from tha king’s palace, N it was not meet 4 us 2 see tha king’s dishonour, therefore have we sent N certified tha king;

Dat search may be made in tha book of tha records of ur fathers: so will u find in tha book of tha records, N know dat dis city is a rebellious city, N hurtful 2 kings N provinces, N dat dey have moved sedition within tha same of old time: 4 which cause was dis city destroyed.
We certify tha king dat, if dis city be builded again, N tha walls of it set up, by dis means u will have no portion on dis side tha river.
Then sent tha king an answer 2 Rehum tha chancellor, N 2 Shimshai tha scribe, N 2 tha rest of their companions dat live in Samaria, N 2 tha rest beyond tha river, Peace, N at such a time.
Tha letter which y’all sent 2 us has been plainly read before me.
N I commanded, N search has been made, N it is found dat dis city of old time has made insurrection against kings, N dat rebellion N sedition have been made in it.
There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond tha river; N toll, tribute, N custom, was paid 2 ’em.
Give y’all now commandment 2 cause dese men 2 cease, N dat dis city don’t be builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.
Pay attention now dat y’all fail not 2 do dis: why should damage grow 2 tha hurt of tha kings?
Now when tha copy of king Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, N Shimshai tha scribe, N their companions, dey went up in haste 2 Jerusalem 2 tha Jews, N made ’em 2 cease by force N power.
Then ceased tha work of tha house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased 2 tha second year of tha reign of Darius king of Persia.

5.text: Then tha prophets, Haggai tha prophet, N Zechariah tha son of Iddo, prophesied 2 tha Jews dat were in Judah N Jerusalem in tha name of tha God of Israel, even 2 ’em.
Then rose up Zerubbabel tha son of Shealtiel, N Jeshua tha son of Jozadak, N began 2 build tha house of God which is at Jerusalem: N wit ’em were tha prophets of God helping ’em.
At tha same time came 2 ’em Tatnai, governor on dis side tha river, N Shethar-boznai, N their companions, N said like dis 2 ’em, Who has commanded u 2 build dis house, N 2 make up dis wall?
Then said we 2 ’em after dis manner, What r tha namez of tha men dat make dis buildin?
But tha eye of their God was upon tha elders of tha Jews, dat dey could not cause ’em 2 cease, till tha matter came 2 Darius: N then dey returned answer by letter concerning dis matter.
Tha copy of tha letter dat Tatnai, governor on dis side tha river, N Shethar-boznai, N his companions tha Apharsachites, which were on dis side tha river, sent 2 Darius tha king:
Dey sent a letter 2 him, in which was written like dis; 2 Darius tha king, all peace.

Be it known 2 tha king, dat we went in2 tha province of Judea, 2 tha house of tha great God, which is builded wit great stones, N timber is laid in tha walls, N dis work goes fast on, N prospereth in their hands.
Then asked we dose elders, N said 2 ’em like dis, Who commanded u 2 build dis house, N 2 make up dese walls?
We asked their namez also, 2 certify u, dat we might write tha namez of tha men dat were tha chief of ’em.
N like dis dey returned us answer, sayin, We r tha servants of tha God of heaven N earth, N build tha house dat was builded dese many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded N set up.

But after dat our fathers had provoked tha God of heaven 2 wrath, he gave ’em in2 tha hand of Nebuchadnezzar tha king of Babylon, tha Chaldean, who destroyed dis house, N carried tha people away in2 Babylon.
But in tha first year of Cyrus tha king of Babylon tha same king Cyrus made a decree 2 build dis house of God.

N tha vessels also of gold N silver of tha house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of tha temple dat was in Jerusalem, N brought ’em in2 tha temple of Babylon, dose did Cyrus tha king take out of tha temple of Babylon, N dey were delivered 2 one, whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;
N said 2 him, Take dese vessels, go, carry ’em in2 tha temple dat is in Jerusalem, N let tha house of God be builded in his place.
Then came tha same Sheshbazzar, N laid tha foundation of tha house of God which is in Jerusalem: N since dat time even until now has it been in buildin, N yet it is not finished.

Now therefore, if it seem good 2 tha king, let there be search made in tha king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so, dat a decree was made of Cyrus tha king 2 build dis house of God at Jerusalem, N let tha king send his pleasure 2 us concerning dis matter.

6.text: Then Darius tha king made a decree, N search was made in tha house of tha rolls, where tha treasures were laid up in Babylon.
N there was found at Achmetha, in tha palace dat is in tha province of tha Medes, a roll, N in it was a record like dis written:

In tha first year of Cyrus tha king tha same Cyrus tha king made a decree concerning tha house of God at Jerusalem, Let tha house be builded, tha place where dey offered sacrifices, N let tha foundations of it be strongly laid; tha height of it threescore cubits, N tha breadth of it threescore cubits;
Wit three rows of great stones, N a row of new timber: N let tha expenses be given out of tha king’s house:

N also let tha golden N silver vessels of tha house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of tha temple which is at Jerusalem, N brought 2 Babylon, be restored, N brought again 2 tha temple which is at Jerusalem, every one 2 his place, N place ’em in tha house of God.
Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond tha river, Shethar-boznai, N ur companions tha Apharsachites, which r beyond tha river, be y’all far from thence:
Let tha work of dis house of God alone; let tha governor of tha Jews N tha elders of tha Jews build dis house of God in his place.

Moreover I make a decree what y’all shall do 2 tha elders of dese Jews 4 tha buildin of dis house of God: dat of tha king’s goods, even of tha tribute beyond tha river, right away expenses be given 2 dese men, dat dey don’t be hindered.

N dat which dey have need of, both young bullocks, N rams, N lambs, 4 tha burnt offerings of tha God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, N oil, according 2 tha appointment of tha priests which r at Jerusalem, let it be given ’em day by day without fail:
Dat dey may offer sacrifices of sweet savours 2 tha God of heaven, N pray 4 tha life of tha king, N of his sons.
Also I have made a decree, dat whoever shall alter dis word, let timber be pulled down from his house, N bein set up, let him be hanged thereon; N let his house be made a dunghill 4 dis.

N tha God dat has caused his name 2 live there destroy all kings N people, dat shall put 2 their hand 2 alter N 2 destroy dis house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done wit speed.
Then Tatnai, governor on dis side tha river, Shethar-boznai, N their companions, according 2 dat which Darius tha king had sent, so dey did speedily.

N tha elders of tha Jews builded, N dey prospered through tha prophesying of Haggai tha prophet N Zechariah tha son of Iddo. N dey builded, N finished it, according 2 tha commandment of tha God of Israel, N according 2 tha commandment of Cyrus, N Darius, N Artaxerxes king of Persia.
N dis house was finished on tha third day of tha month Adar, which was in tha sixth year of tha reign of Darius tha king.
N tha children of Israel, tha priests, N tha Levites, N tha rest of tha children of tha captivity, kept tha dedication of dis house of God wit joy,

N offered at tha dedication of dis house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; N 4 a sin offering 4 all Israel, twelve he goats, according 2 tha number of tha tribes of Israel.
N dey set tha priests in their divisions, N tha Levites in their courses, 4 tha service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in tha book of Moses.
N tha children of tha captivity kept tha passover upon tha fourteenth day of tha first month.
4 tha priests N tha Levites were purified together, all of ’em were pure, N killed tha passover 4 all tha children of tha captivity, N 4 their brothers tha priests, N 4 themselves.
N tha children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, N all such as had separated themselves 2 ’em from tha filthiness of tha heathen of tha land, 2 seek tha LORD God of Israel, did eat,

N kept tha feast of unleavened bread seven days wit joy: 4 tha LORD had made ’em joyful, N turned tha heart of tha king of Assyria 2 ’em, 2 strengthen their hands in tha work of tha house of God, tha God of Israel.

7.text: Now after dese things, in tha reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra tha son of Seraiah, tha son of Azariah, tha son of Hilkiah,
Tha son of Shallum, tha son of Zadok, tha son of Ahitub,
Tha son of Amariah, tha son of Azariah, tha son of Meraioth,
Tha son of Zerahiah, tha son of Uzzi, tha son of Bukki,
Tha son of Abishua, tha son of Phinehas, tha son of Eleazar, tha son of Aaron tha chief priest:

Dis Ezra went up from Babylon; N he was a ready scribe in tha law of Moses, which tha LORD God of Israel had given: N tha king granted him all his request, according 2 tha hand of tha LORD his God upon him.
N there went up some of tha children of Israel, N of tha priests, N tha Levites, N tha singers, N tha porters, N tha Nethinims, 2 Jerusalem, in tha seventh year of Artaxerxes tha king.
N he came 2 Jerusalem in tha fifth month, which was in tha seventh year of tha king.
4 upon tha first day of tha first month began he 2 go up from Babylon, N on tha first day of tha fifth month came he 2 Jerusalem, according 2 tha good hand of his God upon him.
4 Ezra had prepared his heart 2 seek tha law of tha LORD, N 2 do it, N 2 teach in Israel statutes N judgments.
Now dis is tha copy of tha letter dat tha king Artaxerxes gave 2 Ezra tha priest, tha scribe, even a scribe of tha words of tha commandments of tha LORD, N of his statutes 2 Israel.
Artaxerxes, king of kings, 2 Ezra tha priest, a scribe of tha law of tha God of heaven, perfect peace, N at such a time.
I make a decree, dat all dey of tha people of Israel, N of his priests N Levites, in my realm, which r minded of their own freewill 2 go up 2 Jerusalem, go wit u.
Forasmuch as u r sent of tha king, N of his seven counsellors, 2 enquire concerning Judah N Jerusalem, according 2 tha law of ur God which is in thine hand;
N 2 carry tha silver N gold, which tha king N his counsellors have freely offered 2 tha God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,
N all tha silver N gold dat u can find in all tha province of Babylon, wit tha freewill offering of tha people, N of tha priests, offering willingly 4 tha house of their God which is in Jerusalem:
Dat u may buy speedily wit dis money bullocks, rams, lambs, wit their food offerings N their drink offerings, N offer ’em upon tha altar of tha house of ur God which is in Jerusalem.
N whatever shall seem good 2 u, N 2 ur brothers, 2 do wit tha rest of tha silver N tha gold, dat do after tha will of ur God.
Tha vessels also dat r given u 4 tha service of tha house of ur God, dose deliver u before tha God of Jerusalem.
N whatever more shall be needful 4 tha house of ur God, which u will have occasion 2 bestow, bestow it out of tha king’s treasure house.

N I, even I Artaxerxes tha king, do make a decree 2 all tha treasurers which r beyond tha river, dat whatever Ezra tha priest, tha scribe of tha law of tha God of heaven, shall require of u, it be done speedily,
2 an hundred talents of silver, N 2 an hundred measures of wheat, N 2 an hundred baths of wine, N 2 an hundred baths of oil, N salt without prescribing how much.
Whatever is commanded by tha God of heaven, let it be diligently done 4 tha house of tha God of heaven: 4 why should there be wrath against tha realm of tha king N his sons?
Also we certify u, dat touching any of tha priests N Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of dis house of God, it shall not be lawful 2 impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon ’em.

N u, Ezra, after tha wisdom of ur God, dat is in thine hand, set magistrates N judges, which may judge all tha people dat r beyond tha river, all such as know tha laws of ur God; N teach y’all ’em dat know ’em not.
N whoever will not do tha law of ur God, N tha law of tha king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether it be 2 death, or 2 banishment, or 2 confiscation of goods, or 2 imprisonment.
Blessed be tha LORD God of our fathers, which has put such a thing as dis in tha king’s heart, 2 beautify tha house of tha LORD which is in Jerusalem:

N has extended mercy 2 me before tha king, N his counsellors, N before all tha king’s mighty princes. N I was strengthened as tha hand of tha LORD my God was upon me, N I gathered together out of Israel chief men 2 go up wit me.

8.text: Dese r now tha chief of their fathers, N dis is tha genealogy of ’em dat went up wit me from Babylon, in tha reign of Artaxerxes tha king.
Of tha sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of tha sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of tha sons of David; Hattush.
Of tha sons of Shechaniah, of tha sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: N wit him were reckoned by genealogy of tha males an hundred N fifty.
Of tha sons of Pahath-moab; Elihoenai tha son of Zerahiah, N wit him two hundred males.
Of tha sons of Shechaniah; tha son of Jahaziel, N wit him three hundred males.
Of tha sons also of Adin; Ebed tha son of Jonathan, N wit him fifty males.
N of tha sons of Elam; Jeshaiah tha son of Athaliah, N wit him seventy males.
N of tha sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah tha son of Michael, N wit him fourscore males.
Of tha sons of Joab; Obadiah tha son of Jehiel, N wit him two hundred N eighteen males.
N of tha sons of Shelomith; tha son of Josiphiah, N wit him an hundred N threescore males.
N of tha sons of Bebai; Zechariah tha son of Bebai, N wit him twenty N eight males.
N of tha sons of Azgad; Johanan tha son of Hakkatan, N wit him an hundred N ten males.
N of tha last sons of Adonikam, whose namez r dese, Eliphelet, Jeiel, N Shemaiah, N wit ’em threescore males.
Of tha sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, N Zabbud, N wit ’em seventy males.
N I gathered ’em together 2 tha river dat runs 2 Ahava; N there stayed we in tents three days: N I viewed tha people, N tha priests, N found there none of tha sons of Levi.
Then sent I 4 Eliezer, 4 Ariel, 4 Shemaiah, N 4 Elnathan, N 4 Jarib, N 4 Elnathan, N 4 Nathan, N 4 Zechariah, N 4 Meshullam, chief men; also 4 Joiarib, N 4 Elnathan, men of understanding.

N I sent ’em wit commandment 2 Iddo tha chief at tha place Casiphia, N I told ’em what dey should say 2 Iddo, N 2 his brothers tha Nethinims, at tha place Casiphia, dat dey should bring 2 us ministers 4 tha house of our God.
N by tha good hand of our God upon us dey brought us a man of understanding, of tha sons of Mahli, tha son of Levi, tha son of Israel; N Sherebiah, wit his sons N his brothers, eighteen;
N Hashabiah, N wit him Jeshaiah of tha sons of Merari, his brothers N their sons, twenty;
Also of tha Nethinims, whom David N tha princes had appointed 4 tha service of tha Levites, two hundred N twenty Nethinims: all of ’em were expressed by name.
Then I proclaimed a fast there, at tha river of Ahava, dat we might afflict ourselves before our God, 2 seek of him a right way 4 us, N 4 our little ones, N 4 all our substance.

4 I was ashamed 2 require of tha king a band of soldiers N horsemen 2 help us against tha opp in tha way: because we had spoken 2 tha king, sayin, tha hand of our God is upon all ’em 4 good dat seek him; but his power N his wrath is against all ’em dat forsake him.
So we fasted N besought our God 4 dis: N he was intreated of us.
Then I separated twelve of tha chief of tha priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, N ten of their brothers wit ’em,
N weighed 2 ’em tha silver, N tha gold, N tha vessels, even tha offering of tha house of our God, which tha king, N his counsellors, N his lords, N all Israel there present, had offered:
I even weighed 2 their hand six hundred N fifty talents of silver, N silver vessels an hundred talents, N of gold an hundred talents;
Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; N two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
N I said 2 ’em, y’all r holy 2 tha LORD; tha vessels r holy also; N tha silver N tha gold r a freewill offering 2 tha LORD God of ur fathers.
Watch y’all, N keep ’em, until y’all weigh ’em before tha chief of tha priests N tha Levites, N chief of tha fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in tha chambers of tha house of tha LORD.
So took tha priests N tha Levites tha weight of tha silver, N tha gold, N tha vessels, 2 bring ’em 2 Jerusalem 2 tha house of our God.

Then we departed from tha river of Ahava on tha twelfth day of tha first month, 2 go 2 Jerusalem: N tha hand of our God was upon us, N he delivered us from tha hand of tha opp, N of such as lay in wait by tha way.
N we came 2 Jerusalem, N stayed there three days.

Now on tha fourth day was tha silver N tha gold N tha vessels weighed in tha house of our God by tha hand of Meremoth tha son of Uriah tha priest; N wit him was Eleazar tha son of Phinehas; N wit ’em was Jozabad tha son of Jeshua, N Noadiah tha son of Binnui, Levites;
By number N by weight of every one: N all tha weight was written at dat time.

Also tha children of dose dat had been carried away, which were come out of tha captivity, offered burnt offerings 2 tha God of Israel, twelve bullocks 4 all Israel, ninety N six rams, seventy N seven lambs, twelve he goats 4 a sin offering: all dis was a burnt offering 2 tha LORD.
N dey delivered tha king’s commissions 2 tha king’s lieutenants, N 2 tha governors on dis side tha river: N dey furthered tha people, N tha house of God.

9.text: Now when dese things were done, tha princes came 2 me, sayin, tha people of Israel, N tha priests, N tha Levites, have not separated themselves from tha people of tha lands, doin according 2 their abominations, even of tha Canaanites, tha Hittites, tha Perizzites, tha Jebusites, tha Ammonites, tha Moabites, tha Egyptians, N tha Amorites.

4 dey have taken of their daughters 4 themselves, N 4 their sons: so dat tha holy seed have mingled themselves wit tha people of dose lands: yeah, tha hand of tha princes N rulers has been chief in dis trespass.
N when I heard dis thing, I rent my garment N my mantle, N plucked off tha hair of my head N of my beard, N sat down astonied.
Then were assembled 2 me every one dat trembled at tha words of tha God of Israel, because of tha transgression of dose dat had been carried away; N I sat astonied until tha evening sacrifice.
N at tha evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; N havin rent my garment N my mantle, I fell upon my knees, N spread out my hands 2 tha LORD my God,
N said, O my God, I am ashamed N blush 2 lift up my face 2 u, my God: 4 our iniquities r increased over our head, N our trespass is grown up 2 tha heavenz.

Since tha days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass 2 dis day; N 4 our iniquities have we, our kings, N our priests, been delivered in2 tha hand of tha kings of tha lands, 2 tha sword, 2 captivity, N 2 a spoil, N 2 confusion of face, as it is dis day.

N now 4 a little space grace has been showed from tha LORD our God, 2 leave us a remnant 2 escape, N 2 give us a nail in his holy place, dat our God may lighten our eyes, N give us a little reviving in our bondage.

4 we were bondmen; yet our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended mercy 2 us in tha sight of tha kings of Persia, 2 give us a reviving, 2 set up tha house of our God, N 2 repair tha desolations of it, N 2 give us a wall in Judah N in Jerusalem.
N now, O our God, what shall we say after dis? 4 we have forsaken ur commandments,

Which u have commanded by ur servants tha prophets, sayin, tha land, 2 which y’all go 2 possess it, is an unclean land wit tha filthiness of tha people of tha lands, wit their abominations, which have filled it from one end 2 another wit their uncleanness.

Now therefore give not ur daughters 2 their sons, neither take their daughters 2 ur sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth 4 ever: dat y’all may be strong, N eat tha good of tha land, N leave it 4 an inheritance 2 ur children 4 ever.
N after all dat is come upon us 4 our evil deeds, N 4 our great trespass, seein dat u our God have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, N have given us such deliverance as dis;
Should we again break ur commandments, N join in affinity wit tha people of dese abominations? would not u be angry wit us till u had consumed us, so dat there should be no remnant nor escaping?
O LORD God of Israel, u r righteous: 4 we remain yet escaped, as it is dis day: look, we r before u in our trespasses: 4 we cannot stand before u because of dis.

10.text: Now when Ezra had prayed, N when he had confessed, weepin N castin himself down before tha house of God, there assembled 2 him out of Israel a very great congregation of men N women N children: 4 tha people wept very sore.

N Shechaniah tha son of Jehiel, one of tha sons of Elam, answered 2 Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, N have taken strange wives of tha people of tha land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning dis thing.

Now therefore let us make a covenant wit our God 2 put away all tha wives, N such as r born of ’em, according 2 tha counsel of my lord, N of dose dat tremble at tha commandment of our God; N let it be done according 2 tha law.
Arise; 4 dis matter belongs 2 u: we also will be wit u: be of good courage, N do it.
Then arose Ezra, N made tha chief priests, tha Levites, N all Israel, 2 swear dat dey should do according 2 dis word. N dey sware.

Then Ezra rose up from before tha house of God, N went in2 tha chamber of Johanan tha son of Eliashib: N when he came there, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: 4 he mourned because of tha transgression of ’em dat had been carried away.
N dey made proclamation throughout Judah N Jerusalem 2 all tha children of tha captivity, dat dey should gather themselves together 2 Jerusalem;

N dat whoever would not come within three days, according 2 tha counsel of tha princes N tha elders, all his substance should be forfeited, N himself separated from tha congregation of dose dat had been carried away.

Then all tha men of Judah N Benjamin gathered themselves together 2 Jerusalem within three days. It was tha ninth month, on tha twentieth day of tha month; N all tha people sat in tha street of tha house of God, tremblin because of dis matter, N 4 tha great rain.
N Ezra tha priest stood up, N said 2 ’em, y’all have transgressed, N have taken strange wives, 2 increase tha trespass of Israel.
Now therefore make confession 2 tha LORD God of ur fathers, N do his pleasure: N separate y’all from tha people of tha land, N from tha strange wives.
Then all tha congregation answered wit a loud voice, As u have said, so must we do.
But tha people r many, N it is a time of much rain, N we r not able 2 stand without, neither is dis a work of one day or two: 4 we r many dat have transgressed in dis thing.

Let now our rulers of all tha congregation stand, N let all ’em which have taken strange wives in our citiez come at appointed times, N wit ’em tha elders of every city, N tha judges of it, until tha fierce wrath of our God 4 dis matter be turned from us.
Only Jonathan tha son of Asahel N Jahaziah tha son of Tikvah were employed about dis matter: N Meshullam N Shabbethai tha Levite helped ’em.

N tha children of tha captivity did so. N Ezra tha priest, wit certain chief of tha fathers, after tha house of their fathers, N all of ’em by their namez, were separated, N sat down in tha first day of tha tenth month 2 examine tha matter.
N dey made an end wit all tha men dat had taken strange wives by tha first day of tha first month.
N among tha sons of tha priests there were found dat had taken strange wives: namely, of tha sons of Jeshua tha son of Jozadak, N his brothers; Maaseiah, N Eliezer, N Jarib, N Gedaliah.
N dey gave their hands dat dey would put away their wives; N bein guilty, dey offered a ram of tha flock 4 their trespass.
N of tha sons of Immer; Hanani, N Zebadiah.
N of tha sons of Harim; Maaseiah, N Elijah, N Shemaiah, N Jehiel, N Uzziah.
N of tha sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, N Elasah.
Also of tha Levites; Jozabad, N Shimei, N Kelaiah, (tha same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, N Eliezer.
Of tha singers also; Eliashib: N of tha porters; Shallum, N Telem, N Uri.
Moreover of Israel: of tha sons of Parosh; Ramiah, N Jeziah, N Malchiah, N Miamin, N Eleazar, N Malchijah, N Benaiah.
N of tha sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, N Jehiel, N Abdi, N Jeremoth, N Eliah.

Of tha sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, N Athlai.
N of tha sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, N Adaiah, Jashub, N Sheal, N Ramoth.
N of tha sons of Pahath-moab; Adna, N Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, N Binnui, N Manasseh.
N of tha sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

Of tha sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, N Shimei.

Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,

N Bani, N Binnui, Shimei,
